no_environment: No environment to run in yet.
why_missing: no {missing}: the gears that need it cannot start there
read_failed: The infra services could not be read: {error}
replace_body: Two services may not give the same capability, so {dropped} leaves the product with its settings.
linked: {gear} reads {field} from {capability}: save the product to put it in product.gdl.
remove_nothing_depends: No need of the gears depends on it.
remove_leaves_database: {needs} then has no provider (the database falls back to the environment's own Postgres).
remove_stays: What already runs in an environment stays there until it is uninstalled.
about_links: What the gears need running beside them — a database, a sign-in provider — and the service that gives it. A gear field reads what a service gives by name: Link makes the field read ${OIDC_ISSUER} in the product's configuration.
about_environments: The product chooses the services, their image and settings. Each environment places them, gives them a public address and secrets, and keeps its own copy of the image: that is in Releases.
needs_unknown: What the gears need is not known yet.
needs_unknown_body: It shows once the product is checked for the profile an environment runs: open Backend.
link_unknown: which field reads it is not known
image_not_locked: not locked yet: the product lock pins its digest
copy_in_registry: its copy is in the registry
no_copy_in_registry: no copy of this image in its registry
image_label: {name}'s image, as its publisher names it
image_hint: Another tag is another version; each environment then needs its own copy of it (Releases › Images).
settings_hint: One KEY=value per line, given to its container as is. Secrets ({secrets}) are each environment's.
same_path: two files have the same path
public_address_required: What it gives the product says it, so a deploy is refused without one.
public_address_ingress: Placed with the product, its chart routes this address to it with an Ingress.
files_hint: Text may say {secret.KEY}, {host}, {public_url} and {namespace}, filled at deploy; with a secret the files are kept in a Secret. A ready chart does not apply them.
realm_hint: The realm template imports {path} with clients {clients}; the confidential one's secret is {secret.{secret}}, made once per environment.
arguments_hint: One per line, after the passport's ({args}).
